package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_json_decoder_without_reuse_for_stream: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag JSON decoders created for each element of a stream instead of decoding the stream once.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule591PositiveRecord struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Count int `json:"count"` }

func scenario591Positive(chunks []io.Reader) (int, error) {
	total := 0
	for _, chunk := range chunks {
		dec := json.NewDecoder(chunk)
		var rec Rule591PositiveRecord
		if err := dec.Decode(&rec); err != nil { return 0, err }
		total += rec.Count
	}
	return total, nil
}
